讚美之泉
詞：曾祥怡、游智婷／曲：曾祥怡

lines.b: Thank You Lord, You died for me

lines.a: 祢的身體 為我而捨
lines.b: With love, You gave Your life for me

lines.a: 帶我出黑暗 進入光明國度
lines.b: Brought me from darkness into the world of light
Praise You Lord, Your love for me

lines.a: 祢的寶血 為我而流
lines.b: Your blood of grace flows over me

lines.a: 寶貴十架上 醫治恩典湧流
lines.b: Your tender mercy pours down from Calvary
Your love has set me so free

lines.a: 寶貴十架的大能 賜我生命
lines.b: The precious cross, by its pow'r I am set free

lines.a: 主耶穌 我俯伏敬拜祢
lines.b: With my all, I worship at Your feet

lines.a: 寶貴十架的救恩 是祢所立的約
lines.b: Your saving grace, so secure in this promise of old
It's Your love unchanging for me
